name: feature-relative residual envelope prototype
threshold_rule: per-depth 95th percentile of actual GFL correction RMS divided by pre-adapter feature RMS over the frozen 26-object set and 50 denoising steps
formula: r_scaled = min(requested_scale, layer_cap) * r; q = RMS(r_scaled) / (RMS(h) + eps); g = min(1, tau_depth / (q + eps)); h_out = h + g * r_scaled

methods.c3_feature_gate: C3 low/high/low schedule with the frozen feature-relative gate
methods.linear_feature_gate: endpoint-matched generic linear schedule with the same frozen gate

inference_cost: One residual RMS, one feature RMS, scalar gate calculation, and elementwise multiplication per adapter call; no model, training, VAE, or extra feature-network pass.
ablation: Set MVP_GATE_ENABLED=0 to run the same schedules without attenuation.
selection_policy: No color metric, visual judgment, or outcome from the proposed runs is used to tune tau.
